items.title: Home Depot, Klarna Q2 earnings shed light on strength of the consumer
items.summary: Retailer Home Depot (HD) and buy now, pay later service Klarna (KLAR) both released their second quarter earnings results on Tuesday, helping shed some additional light on the health of the US consumer. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to cover what this all signifies about the ongoing strength of consumers.
